primary_metric: Macro mean V/U/R over the 13 test cases after averaging seeds; paired bootstrap on all three metrics versus the frozen controls, plus the SZH-aligned R@13 three-seed comparison.
split_rule: Same case IDs, seeds, budget, sampling and per-attempt seed schedule as the frozen protocols. skeleton_complete_forced_valid shares its prompts with skeleton_complete_forced, so its raw responses for seeds 17/42 (16 calls) and seed 2026 (first 13 calls) are reused verbatim from the frozen runs with the request-id method label relabeled; only seed-2026 calls 14-16 use fresh inference. The joint variant changes prompts, so all of its cells use fresh inference.
dev_decision: On the frozen dev split (4 cases, seed 17, budget 16): skeleton_complete_forced_valid reached V 67.19%, U 37.50%, R 23.26%; skeleton_complete_forced_valid_joint reached V 71.88%, U 64.06%, R 64.30%, versus V 53.12%, U 45.31%, R 21.91% for skeleton_complete_forced and V 50.00%, U 25.00%, R 13.36% for parent_set. Both new variants were frozen for test inference before any test result was inspected.
method_definition: skeleton_complete_forced_valid keeps the forced-backbone prompt and applies validity-filtered assembly: each parsed addition is accepted, in parsed order, only while the union stays acyclic, within the edge budget and free of unwanted reachability; already-valid proposals are reproduced exactly, so V and R cannot decrease per cell. skeleton_complete_forced_valid_joint additionally fixes the feasible parent set of a second node within each stratum (two-level hierarchy, round-robin across strata and their second-level parent sets) before the same filtered assembly. No coverage feedback, no edit actions, no representation change.
